name: Respect Kansas 2020

venue.name: Reliance Community Church
venue.details: Enter through the main doors and follow the signs.

information: # This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak. Please make sure you are familiar with the [WCA Regulations.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) We will be relying on volunteer judges throughout the day. Judging will be covered at the competitor tutorial at the beginning of the day. If you are new to competing, [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww) should help cover the basics.
